target_gates.description: Head, torso, pelvis, and tail form one coherent creature silhouette.
Exactly two readable wings attach near the shoulders.
Exactly two hind legs attach to the pelvis and bear weight.
The shoulder wings occupy the forelimb positions and no extra front leg pair is visible.
A four-legged dragon, bird, wingless serpent, or extra-limbed chimera does not substitute.
All necks belong to one grounded torso and limb system.
At least three complete neck paths remain visible.
Each neck has a separate non-merged root on the shared shoulder system.
Heads retain distinct silhouettes, jaws, and orientations.
A snake bundle, duplicated bodies, head halo, or three-headed dog does not substitute.
